comment: No source is published. The four CV inputs multiply their knobs rather than adding to them, the same pattern as Damonitu: a factor of one is substituted when the jack is empty, so a cable resting at 0V pulls the parameter to its clamp floor. The module returns early from process while the clock input is empty, so it does nothing at all with no clock patched. The bass output really is an octave below the chord: the note minus twelve is stored as element zero of the chord vector, and the chord output's channel loop begins at element one, so the bass note is not repeated there. The README lists the voicings as default, rootless, open and three notes; the maker's own wording is DEFAULT, OPEN, ROOTLESS and THREE NOTES, and the order of the last two could not be settled, so the line names them without claiming an order. The bass inversion parameter is configured 1 to 3 rather than 0 to 2, and the display names its three settings ROOT, 1ST INV and 2ND INV.
